findings.message: The runtime-libraries part removed libgomp1_libs from stage-packages. The service command /usr/bin/demo serve --engine parallel loads parallel.so, which requires libgomp.so.1 as a mandatory DT_NEEDED dependency. Removing this slice leaves no other source for the library in the base, remaining slices, or full deb dependency closure. The application will exit at startup. Restore libgomp1_libs or confirm the removal is intentional and documented in the PR description.

summary: Trigger commit updated; proposed recipe removes libgomp1_libs slice from runtime-libraries part. EOL cap (2026-12-01, ~46 days) and track naming pass. Deb security manifest correctly present. Recipe regression fails: removed library is mandatory for configured service engine.
